evidence: Adds shared BIP352 cryptographic and address primitives to src/common/bip352.{h,cpp} and src/key.h wrapping libsecp256k1.
rationale: Implements the core cryptographic primitives and receiver scanning interfaces for BIP352 Silent Payments in common infrastructure. This strategically important foundation unblocks wallet sending/receiving and node-level indexing for light clients as tracked in #28536.
